# This directory stores Phase 2 pre-built artefacts:
#
#   attack_embeddings.npy   – SBERT embeddings of malicious training prompts
#   faiss_index.bin         – FAISS IndexFlatL2 built from the above
#
# These files are generated by the build scripts and are listed in .gitignore
# to avoid committing large binary files to version control.
#
# Build order:
#   Step 1: python scripts/build_embeddings.py      (requires sentence-transformers + GPU)
#   Step 2: python scripts/build_faiss_index.py     (requires faiss-cpu)
